subject: How do I store selected input in a dynamic vector/list?

messages.author: d6ffe8b5633d6bb1
messages.subject: How do I store selected input in a dynamic vector/list?
parts:
Hi, my friends and I love playing the Settlers of Catan board game. I'm trying to build a web app that records the dice roll and automatically updates a histogram of all dice rolls (two dice rolled per turn, 2-12 outcome).

Right now, the outcome of rolling two dice is recorded by selecting from a radioButtons panel, with buttons 2 through 12. I wrote code to append the outcome of the roll to an empty vector. However, R doesn't seem to be recognizing that I want to append to an existing vector that was declared before the shinyServer() function. Please see below. How do I change the code so that any radioButtons input selection is appended to an existing vector/list? I basically want the vector to grow dynamically with each selection of the radioButtons panel so that it can be plotted with the hist() function. (I recognize that radioButtons may not be the best choice either as two of the same number can be rolled consecutively, so say rolling two 10s in a row would mean selecting 10 twice in the radioButtons panel.) Thanks for your help!!

roll.list <- c() # Initiate the empty vector

shinyServer(function(input, output){
  
    rollInput <- reactive(function(){
    
    roll.list <- c(roll.list, input$roll) # The roll is recorded as a number in a radioButtons panel and needs to be appended to roll.list
    return(roll.list)
    
  })

  output$rollPlot <- reactivePlot(function(){
    
    num <- as.numeric(rollInput())

    hist(num)
    
  })
  
})

roll.list <<- c(roll.list, input$roll)

Note the double < characters in the assign. This'll help but it's not a complete solution. Shiny is not really set up that well for imperative actions like this but we should have at least a very nice workaround soon.
